description: Ministry of Justice - Reparations Policies & Guidelines - 2021
reasoning: This gazette content contains the "Reparations Policies & Guidelines 2021" formulated by the Office for Reparations under the Office for Reparations Act, No. 34 of 2018. It establishes a comprehensive regulatory framework and policy guidelines for reparations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it creates a structured legal and policy approach to addressing reparations rather than dealing with government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
